ops.title: Monitor upstream for apple/container and socktainer releases
ops.description:
Standing upstream re-check that keeps the hermes-on-Apple-container NO-GO from going stale (part of the "keep improving" ask under task 89dbaae / memo note 452679f). Monthly: check apple/container + socktainer releases and the 5 trigger issues, append to cc-notes log `apple-container-prototype`, notify the user only when a trigger moved.

Triggers to watch (any movement flips the re-evaluation):
- apple/container#158 — boot autostart (currently OPEN, per-user LaunchAgent only)
- apple/container#286 — `--restart` policy (currently OPEN; socktainer has its own process-scoped one)
- apple/container#66 — Docker Engine API compat (closed not-planned; a reversal is a big trigger)
- an egress / network-policy primitive landing (maintainer declined pfctl in #719)
- memory ballooning completion (freed guest pages relinquished to host — technical-overview.md)
- new container / socktainer releases (baseline: container 1.1.0 2026-07-06, socktainer v1.1.1 2026-07-14)

Implemented in-session as a CronCreate job (session-only, 7-day expiry) — this backlog task is the durable record so a future session re-arms it. Cadence: monthly, off-peak minute.

ops.text: A recurring check exists (CronCreate job this session; re-armed by a future session) that compares apple/container + socktainer latest releases against the recorded baseline (container 1.1.0 / socktainer v1.1.1) and the 5 trigger issues (#158, #286, #66, egress primitive, ballooning), and appends the result to cc-notes log apple-container-prototype
The user is notified only when a trigger has moved (a new release or an issue state change), not on a no-change run
